title: Recipe library adapter
summary: Compile a JSON recipe catalog and optional guidance; read catalog pages or one recipe with immutable resource pins. Reading a recipe never invokes its listed capabilities.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: compile_package
operations.notes: No deadline. point-library surface, declared uses, bounded entries/steps and result-fit checks; rejects recipes naming undeclared capabilities. ValueError maps at Host load.

operations.name: contents

output.description: Tuple (entry list, guidance string or None).

operations.notes: No deadline is enforced by this synchronous Python seam. Retrying a read observes the current state.

operations.name: invoke

output.description: ToolResult with bounded catalog page or complete recipe.

operations.notes: No deadline; reads do not execute recipe steps. Catalog query uses English keywords and whole rows are removed until the answer fits; entry and query selectors cannot be mixed.

invariants.text: Library recipes hold no independent authority and are not executed by reading them.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.

op.description: catalog lists what this library has; entry returns one recipe.

query.description: With catalog: English keywords; the entries that match come first.

entry.description: With entry: an id from the catalog.
